versions.changelog:
Initial release of the mux-video skill, providing best practices and operational guidance for architecting and running video delivery pipelines with Mux.

- Covers end-to-end video workflow: ingest, transcode, package, secure, and deliver.
- Defines asset lifecycle, playback ID models, and security best practices.
- Emphasizes separation of control planes and operational reliability.
- Details live streaming realities, encoder guidelines, clipping, and observability requirements.
- Includes troubleshooting playbooks, anti-patterns, cost controls, and scaling guidance.
- Outlines mastery signals and extension points for advanced usage.
